roles.title: Chief Technology Officer
roles.summary: Lead the technology team and the company's technology strategy.
highlights: Led the team that implemented solutions to improve efficiency and profitability
Set the technology strategy, including selecting and deploying new systems and infrastructure
Run technology projects to deadline and budget with senior leadership

highlights.text: Lead the technology team and strategy, aligning engineering roadmaps with the company’s growth targets.
Set the technology strategy and lead delivery of the company’s customer-facing web and [mobile] products and APIs.
Own the company’s cloud infrastructure and deployment pipeline, and the selection and roll-out of new systems.
Architect and oversee the company’s web platform and APIs in Angular, Node.js and TypeScript, serving [N customers].
Selected and deployed new systems and infrastructure that improved operational efficiency by [efficiency gain %].
Moved web and API services to containerised deployments with automated CI/CD, cutting release time from [release time before] to [release time after].
Keep production platforms reliable and secure for a regulated finance business [uptime %].
Deliver technology projects to scope, schedule and budget in partnership with senior leadership.
Plan and manage the technology budget and projects with senior leadership.

highlights.text: Co-founded the company; own the technology vision, budget and delivery across software development, architecture, QA, operations and security.
Lead mobile delivery for client apps built with React Native, Flutter and Ionic, from prototype to App Store and Google Play release [N apps shipped].
Oversee production operations, network and systems administration, technical support and information security management.
Lead a team of [N engineers] building web, mobile and payment products for clients including SunTrust Bank, Gifti App and AirtimeFlip.
Define mobile architecture: shared TypeScript and Dart codebases, REST and Firebase backends, and automated release pipelines.
Standardised Docker-based environments and CI/CD pipelines across client projects on AWS, Azure and DigitalOcean [N services].
Set the engineering standards (code review, testing, CI/CD, releases) used on [N projects] from concept to production.
Lead a team of [N engineers] delivering mobile, web and payment products for clients including Gifti App, AirtimeFlip and SunTrust Bank.
Set up monitoring, backups and incident response for client platforms [name the platforms].
Hire, onboard and mentor engineers, growing [N developers] into senior and lead roles.
Own QA and release management, keeping store ratings at [store rating] and crash-free sessions above [crash-free %].
Own the technology budget and infrastructure spend, reducing hosting costs by [hosting cost reduction %].
